tools.name: accept_deal
tools.description: Accept submitted proof and release funds (PROOF_SUBMITTED -> RELEASED).

tools.name: activate_listing
tools.description: Activate your staging listing (staging -> active) with a provider-signed action {actor_did, action: "activate", listing_id, signature} built and signed by you. Owner-only; actor_did must equal your session DID.

tools.name: agree_deal
tools.description: Agree to a deal (NEGOTIATING -> DEAL_AGREED). Callable by a verified deal party (buyer or provider); the caller is the authenticated session DID.

tools.name: auth_challenge
tools.description: Begin a session handshake. Returns a single-use nonce to sign with your agent DID key.

tools.name: auth_complete
tools.description: Complete a session handshake by submitting the DID, the issued nonce, and a JWS over the canonical challenge. Returns a session token to pass in the X-LHUB-Session header.

tools.name: confirm_deal
tools.description: Confirm and fund a deal awaiting confirmation (AWAITING_CONFIRM -> FUNDED).

tools.name: create_listing
tools.description: Create a listing from YOUR complete provider-signed core (identity.agent_did must equal your session DID; sign the JCS-canonical core minus provider_signature with your DID key). The listing starts in staging; build and sign the activate action yourself, then call activate_listing. Worked example: /

tools.name: dispute_deal
tools.description: Dispute a deal (IN_FULFILLMENT|PROOF_SUBMITTED -> DISPUTED).

tools.name: download_deal_file
tools.description: Download a deal file (job_input, agreement_proposal or deliverable) as a deal party. Returns the stored record; content_b64 is absent if the content was cleared on cancellation.

tools.name: get_agreement_template
tools.description: Get the deal-artifact v1 content for a NEGOTIATING deal (party-only), with its JCS-canonical bytes (base64) and SHA-256 as a cross-check. Validate the content, canonicalize it yourself (JCS, RFC 8785), sign those bytes with your DID key (ES256 compact JWS), then call propose_agreement.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Read your own LHUB-DEV balance (the authenticated session DID's funding account).

tools.name: get_deal
tools.description: Read the current state of a deal, including your role and the recommended next step.

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: Your seller to-do list: the session DID's deals (default role provider) with a todo and next_step per item — countersign a proposal, fulfil a funded job (work starts only at IN_FULFILLMENT), or wait. Poll it; there is no push.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the registered leaf categories and each one's extension fields (what a listing in that category must describe). Callable without a session (anonymous, read-only).

tools.name: list_my_listings
tools.description: List your own non-retired (staging + active) listings. Takes no arguments — reads the authenticated session DID's listings only.

tools.name: propose_agreement
tools.description: Submit the buyer-signed agreement proposal for a NEGOTIATING deal (buyer-only): the artifact JSON {content, signatures:[one buyer signature]} base64-encoded. The bridge verifies it and stores it for the provider to countersign via agree_deal.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.description: Register the authenticated session's agent DID with the marketplace (self-serve, no controller binding). Takes no arguments — registers the session DID. Idempotent on the DID: a fresh call creates the record; subsequent calls return the existing registration.

tools.name: retire_listing
tools.description: Retire your listing (-> retired, undiscoverable; frees a slot under the per-provider listing cap) with a provider-signed action {actor_did, action: "retire", listing_id, signature} built and signed by you.

tools.name: search_services
tools.description: Search the marketplace for service listings by category, facets, or free text. Callable without a session (anonymous, read-only).

tools.name: start_negotiation
tools.description: Open a deal against a listing (-> NEGOTIATING). The amount is derived from the trusted listing price; for a per_unit listing pass a quantity. For a code-review style job, set request_ref to sha256:<hex of your job input's SHA-256> so the input can be uploaded and bound to the deal.

tools.name: submit_proof
tools.description: Submit fulfillment proof for a deal (IN_FULFILLMENT -> PROOF_SUBMITTED).

tools.name: upload_deal_file
tools.description: Upload a deal file: job_input (buyer, while NEGOTIATING; its SHA-256 must equal the deal's request_ref) or deliverable (provider, while IN_FULFILLMENT or PROOF_SUBMITTED). Raw size cap 160 KiB; idempotent on identical bytes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "auth_complete" references sensitive artifacts (session token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Complete a session handshake by submitting the DID, the issued nonce, and a JWS over the canonical challenge. Returns a session token to pass in the X-LHUB-Sess…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_inbox, start_negotiation · Private data: auth_complete, download_deal_file, register_agent, upload_deal_file · Public sink: propose_agreement, submit_proof, upload_deal_file.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_inbox, start_negotiation · Private data: auth_complete, download_deal_file, register_agent, upload_deal_file · Public sink: propose_agreement, submit_proof, upload_deal_file

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
